name: CAFA-evaluator
description: We present CAFA-evaluator, a powerful Python program designed to evaluate the performance of prediction methods on targets with hierarchical concept dependencies. It generalizes multi-label evaluation to modern ontologies where the prediction targets are drawn from a directed acyclic graph and achieves high efficiency by leveraging matrix computation and topological sorting. The program requirements include a small number of standard Python libraries, making CAFA-evaluator easy to maintain. The code replicates the Critical Assessment of protein Function Annotation (CAFA) benchmarking, which evaluates predictions of the consistent subgraphs in Gene Ontology. Owing to its reliability and accuracy, the organizers have selected CAFA-evaluator as the official CAFA evaluation software.
evaluation_method: F_max (hierarchy-aware F-measure) and related CAFA-specific metrics (e.g., S_min, precision/recall curves)
typical_sota_score: 30–60% F_max (varies substantially by ontology and organism)
reputation: CAFA-evaluator is the official, well-regarded evaluation software used by the protein function prediction community (CAFA organizers) and is widely trusted for reproducible benchmarking.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on bioinformatics; targets are hierarchical (DAG) labels leading to structured evaluation. Results vary with ontology and annotation density; class imbalance and label sparsity are common. Widely used within CAFA community; potential for method-specific tuning and dataset-specific contamination if training sources overlap with evaluation annotations.
